question.problem:
$$
{x}^{′}=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]x+[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the system of ODEs above. The equilibrium point of the system is $[2,\,-1]^{T}.$ Which of the following is the system obtained by shifting the equilibrium to the origin?
question.worked_solution:
To shift the system's equilibrium from ${x}^{∗}$ to the origin, we define the deviation vector

$$
u=x-{x}^{∗}.
$$

In our case, we have

$$
u=x-[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\,⇒\,x=u+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\,\text{and}\,{x}^{′}={u}^{′}.
$$

Substituting $x$ and ${x}^{′}$ into the given system, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{′} & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]x+[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ {u}^{′} & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}](u+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}])+[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]u+[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]u+[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]u.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the shifted system is

$$
{u}^{′}=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]u.
$$
